rows.grounds: verb of remaining or being left over

items.question: Can even an extremely prosperous enemy survive against such warriors?
premises: The opposing warriors are vast in number and fiercely attacking.
An enemy may be extremely well-endowed and prosperous.
Such force leaves no room for the enemy to endure.
items.inference: Therefore, no enemy remains, however prosperous.
items.plain_english: Even an extremely prosperous enemy does not remain.
